history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration establish standard cost categories for use by each duty station to improve transparency and enable reporting of “cost of the estate per staff member” at each location.
history.administration_response: The Administration considers this recommendation to be implemented and requests its closure. Standard cost categories are now established through commitment items and cost centres. Categories relating to facilities are now clearly defined, enabling transparent grouping under maintenance, services, utilities and consumables (materials), as well as rental (lease-in). It is, however, noted that the costs across duty stations and locations inevitably and significantly differ due to the local and regional circumstances, and therefore benchmarking and measuring costs across locations do not ensure accurate comparisons. It is also noted that, depending on the contractual arrangements with the suppliers in each entity, utilities and services may be either separated or consolidated within one overarching agreement.
history.board_assessment: Given that standard cost categories are now established through commitment items and cost centres, the Board considers the recommendation to be implemented.
